passive_auto.description: Local analysis only; no live request or state change.

active_safe_auto.description: Low-risk active request inside allowlist; disabled by default.

active_requires_approval.description: Live testing, replay, browser/Burp/Caido execution, or fresh repro.

hard_deny.description: Out-of-scope, destructive, forbidden path, or policy violation.

agent_roles.coordinator: Maintains global state, queue, blockers, and next action.
agent_roles.recon_agent: Maps assets, endpoints, parameters, runtime observations, and external signals.
agent_roles.source_mapper: Reads source one file at a time and links file -> flow -> endpoint.
agent_roles.attack_path_planner: Builds hypotheses, chains, and ranked attack paths.
agent_roles.executor: Runs approved tests through browser/Burp/Caido/http under safety policy.
agent_roles.validator: Checks deterministic proof, controls, fresh repro, and repeatability.
agent_roles.evidence_judge: Decides reportability from saved evidence, not model confidence.
agent_roles.report_reviewer: Builds report, missing-proof gate, duplicate/status tracking.
agent_roles.safety_governor: Enforces allowlist, forbidden paths, rate limit, and approval.
agent_roles.data_steward: Controls retention, redaction, sanitized exports, and secret handling.
